analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI remains at 38.9 in neutral territory, and MACD histogram is holding steady at -544.6999 without improvement or deterioration. ADX at 29.8 indicates a trend, but the -DI at 37.1 is dominant, suggesting downward pressure and making directional confirmation premature. Despite a +5.11% move in the last 5 days, the price is still below the 20-day high of 40,585. Confirmation needed on breaking the swing resistance at 30,570.
